import re, glob, os
# Find private methods whose name appears exactly once (only the declaration) within its own file.
decl = re.compile(r'\bprivate\s+(?:static\s+)?(?:final\s+)?(?:<[^>]+>\s+)?[\w\.\[\]<>,\s?]+?\s+(\w+)\s*\(')
candidates=[]
for path in glob.glob('jadx-core/src/main/java/**/*.java', recursive=True):
    with open(path) as f: src=f.read()
    # strip line comments crudely
    for m in decl.finditer(src):
        name=m.group(1)
        if name in ('if','for','while','switch','catch','return','new'): continue
        # count usages of name( and name references and ::name
        uses = len(re.findall(r'\b'+re.escape(name)+r'\b', src))
        if uses==1:
            line=src[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
            candidates.append((path,line,name))
for c in candidates:
    print(f"{c[0]}:{c[1]}  {c[2]}")
print("TOTAL:",len(candidates))
EOF
